title: Elux Legend Blackcurrant Lemonade Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend Blackcurrant Lemonade Nic Salt combines the bold, tangy sweetness of juicy Blackcurrant with the sharp, fizzy bite of classic Lemonade. The result is a fruit-forward vape with a bright, zesty edge and a lingering depth that makes each puff feel full of flavour. Part of the Elux Legend Nic Salt collection, this e-liquid features double-concentrated flavouring for a more intense and satisfying taste that reflects the punchy profiles Elux is known for. With a 50VG/50PG ratio and smooth nicotine salt formulation, Blackcurrant Lemonade is ideal for use with MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices. It delivers vibrant flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths.
